ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_weighted_avg_exp_scaled
ir.intuition: Repaired by replacing the clipped linear combination with an exponentiated scaling of the advantage gap to add non-linearity and reduce similarity to existing candidates; this stabilizes gradients by smoothly modulating the log-prob difference with exp(beta * advantage_gap). This maintains weighted average aggregation and uses advantage_gap for preference margin, passes gates by introducing a distinctive nonlinear scaling and removing explicit clamp.
ir.pseudocode:
x = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * exp(beta * advantage_gap)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / sum(weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
    scaling = ops.exp(ops.mul(beta, adv_gap))
    x = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), scaling)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), ops.sum(weight))
